# Starfighters Space to Host Investor Update on Nov. 6


November 03, 2026 9:00am EST


*Live webcast will review progress on Wind Tunnel in the Sky* ™ *, STARLAUNCH* ™ *and the Company’s commercial strategy*


KENNEDY SPACE CENTER, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Starfighters Space, Inc.](https://starfightersspace.com/) ("Starfighters" or the "Company") (NYSE American: FJET), the space company operating the world's only commercial fleet of flight-ready Mach 2+ supersonic aircraft, today announced that CEO Tim Franta will host a live briefing on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026, at 4p.m. ET.


During the briefing, Franta will provide an update on the Company’s operations and outlook, including:


- Progress on the Wind Tunnel in the Sky™ reusable Mach 2+ airborne testing platform, including the recent completion of its first flight hardware
- Continued development of the STARLAUNCH™ air launch system
- Business development activity across hypersonic research, development, test and evaluation (RDT&E), flight testing of advanced sensors and communications systems, and supersonic pilot training
- Operational priorities and upcoming milestones


“This has been a year of steady progress in building the capabilities that set Starfighters apart, and we want our investors to hear directly from us about where we are and where we are heading,” said Tim Franta, CEO of Starfighters. “This briefing is part of our ongoing commitment to keep investors informed as we execute on our commercial strategy and bring sustained Mach 2+ flight services to customers across the aerospace and defense sectors.”


**Wind Tunnel in the Sky** ™ - Two flight articles have been received and assembled for this program and the Company is performing fit checks to connect them to the existing pylon systems on the F-104.


**STARLAUNCH** ™ - An inert flight article for the suborbital version of STARLAUNCH™ has been designed and is now being fabricated. A captive-carry test flight is planned in December.


**Business Development Activity** - The Company has stepped up its pursuit of business opportunities within 10 capability areas, including flight testing for hypersonic and military systems, materials science, spaceflight hardware validation, microgravity science, supersonic regulatory development, pilot training, human factors and biomedical research, and media/entertainment.


**Operational Priorities and Milestones** - Starfighters has expanded personnel and is investing in management systems to support existing commitments and pursue new opportunities. This has included building relationships with key vendors and partners, including to respond to DoD and NASA solicitations. Beginning with December’s planned captive-carry STARLAUNCH™ test, the Company is working toward a regular cadence of flight operations with Wind Tunnel in the Sky™ to facilitate rideshare opportunities for other revenue-producing customers.


**Briefing Details**


**Date:** Friday, Nov. 6, 2026
**Time:** 4:00 p.m. ET
**Format:** Live webcast
**Registration:**[https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_SwL2dQWHTlue-Sn3LtVUZw](https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_SwL2dQWHTlue-Sn3LtVUZw)


A replay of the briefing will be available following the event on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at[starfightersspace.com](https://starfightersspace.com/) for a period of 30 days.


**About Starfighters Space, Inc.**


[Starfighters Space](https://starfightersspace.com/) (NYSE American: FJET) operates its fleet of F-104 aircraft at Kennedy Space Center in Florida and the Midland International Air & Space Port in Texas, making it the only company in the world with the commercial capability to fly at sustained Mach 2+ speeds, supporting a variety of aerospace applications.
